risk_note: RV2 (db/migrations; price change history for BR-WATCH-05 / BR-WATCH-19, 05 B1-17 first part). Migration 0030 creates app.price_snapshot partitioned by RANGE (first_observed_at) with only its DEFAULT partition (month partitions at runtime via app.ensure_month_partition, whose allow-list and MONTH_PARTITIONED_TABLES gain price_snapshot; function body copied unchanged from 0029). 15 columns, no user identifier of any kind; named CHECKs (source_kind set, price_fen > 0, coupon_fen >= 0, final_price_fen > 0, last_observed_at >= first_observed_at, observation_count >= 1); primary key (id, first_observed_at); index (app_id, product_key, source_kind, first_observed_at DESC). Grants: couli_app SELECT/INSERT plus UPDATE on last_observed_at and observation_count only, no DELETE/TRUNCATE; couli_readonly SELECT. 13-month retention left to a follow-up. schema.sql and db.gen.ts from pnpm db:snapshot on the AWS test machine. Full verification by the required CI checks (ops/approvals.yaml id 21).
